speaker: tape_op
text: This is what a Space looks like after space-tape runs.

speaker: tape_op
text: A replay is just a file. You do not need a browser, and you do not need an X API key.

speaker: second_mic
text: Whisper heard the words. Hydra tagged who was unmuted. About once a second, X writes that into the audio as ID3.

speaker: tape_op
text: HydraAudioLevel slot zero is the host. Everyone else on stage sits in HydraParticipants.

speaker: second_mic
text: If you remux to wav before you parse, those tags are gone. The transcript still has words. It has no speakers.

speaker: tape_op
text: So the pipeline is: yt-dlp, keep the mpegts, parse Hydra, then convert a copy for Whisper.

speaker: second_mic
text: Each Whisper cue gets the Hydra region covering its midpoint. That is the whole diarizer. We are not guessing voices.

speaker: tape_op
text: Overlaps stay labeled as both. The mix is one channel. Do not pretend Whisper can split two people talking at once.

speaker: second_mic
text: The product is cues.json. Start, end, speaker, text. Plus transcript.md and a small mp3 for a player.

speaker: tape_op
text: Always keep the original X URL. Playback on a site is a convenience. X is the source.

speaker: second_mic
text: Public recorded Spaces only. Replays expire, so the download is the archive. Listeners never appear in the tags.

speaker: tape_op
text: If yt-dlp finds no media, stop. The Space was not recorded, or the replay is gone. This tool does not join live.

speaker: second_mic
text: Drop a raw replay on the player page to parse Hydra in the browser. Nothing is uploaded. The file already had the speaker list.

speaker: tape_op
text: That is space-tape. Fork it. Run it on a shell. Host the git as a page.
